topspin.simpleMeaning: Spin that makes the ball fall down faster and go forward after it bounces.
topspin.contextMeaning: Topspin is a type of spin that makes the ball dip and move quickly forward after bouncing.
topspin.translationJa: トップスピンはボールがバウンド後に速く落ちて前に動く回転です。
topspin.translationEs: El topspin es un giro que hace que la bola baje rápido y avance tras botar.
topspin.example: Topspin can make the next shot fast.

what is spin?.simpleMeaning: Spin is when the ball turns around while moving.
what is spin?.contextMeaning: Spin means the ball turns as it moves.
what is spin?.translationJa: スピンはボールが動きながら回ることです。
what is spin?.translationEs: El giro es cuando la bola gira mientras se mueve.
what is spin?.example: Players brush the ball with the racket to make spin.

backspin.simpleMeaning: Spin that makes the ball stay low and move slowly.
backspin.contextMeaning: Backspin is a spin that keeps the ball low and slow.
backspin.translationJa: バックスピンはボールが低くゆっくり動く回転です。
backspin.translationEs: El backspin es un giro que hace que la bola se quede baja y lenta.
backspin.example: A short serve can use backspin.

sidespin.simpleMeaning: Spin that makes the ball curve to the left or right.
sidespin.contextMeaning: Sidespin makes the ball curve left or right.
sidespin.translationJa: サイドスピンはボールを左か右に曲げる回転です。
sidespin.translationEs: El sidespin es un giro que hace que la bola se curve a la izquierda o derecha.
sidespin.example: Watch the bounce to see the effect of sidespin.

how does an official serve begin?.simpleMeaning: The ball starts on an open hand and is thrown up at least 16 cm.
how does an official serve begin?.contextMeaning: In an official serve, the ball starts in the open palm and is tossed nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.
how does an official serve begin?.translationJa: 正式なサーブは手のひらにボールをのせ、少なくとも16センチ上にほうることから始まります。
how does an official serve begin?.translationEs: Un saque oficial comienza con la bola en la palma abierta y se lanza casi recto al menos 16 cm.
how does an official serve begin?.example: The server hits the ball as it falls.

where and when did table tennis begin?.simpleMeaning: Table tennis started in England indoors in the 1880s.
where and when did table tennis begin?.contextMeaning: Table tennis began in England in the 1880s as an indoor form of lawn tennis.
where and when did table tennis begin?.translationJa: 卓球は1880年代にイギリスで屋内のテニスとして始まりました。
where and when did table tennis begin?.translationEs: El tenis de mesa comenzó en Inglaterra en los 1880s como tenis de césped en interiores.
where and when did table tennis begin?.example: People used a dining table and simple equipment.

what olympic firsts are connected to ma.simpleMeaning: Ma Long was the first man to win Olympic men’s singles twice; Mima Ito got Japan’s first Olympic gold and first mixed doubles title.
what olympic firsts are connected to ma.contextMeaning: Ma Long won Olympic men’s singles twice, a first; Mima Ito won first Olympic mixed doubles and Japan’s first table tennis gold.
what olympic firsts are connected to ma.translationJa: 馬龍は男子シングルで五輪２回目の優勝、第１人。伊藤美誠は最初の混合ダブルスと日本初の金メダルを獲得。
what olympic firsts are connected to ma.reading: 馬龍（マー・ロン）、伊藤美誠（いとう みま）
what olympic firsts are connected to ma.translationEs: Ma Long fue el primer hombre en ganar dos oros olímpicos individuales; Mima Ito ganó el primer oro olímpico de Japón y el primero en dobles mixtos.
what olympic firsts are connected to ma.example: Both results include important Olympic firsts.

spin.simpleMeaning: Spin is the ball turning around.
spin.contextMeaning: Spin means the ball turns after it bounces.
spin.translationJa: スピンはボールがバウンド後に回転することです。
spin.translationEs: El giro es el movimiento de la bola girando.
spin.example: Spin changes the ball after it bounces.

brush.simpleMeaning: To touch and move lightly on something.
brush.contextMeaning: Players touch and move softly the ball with the racket.
brush.translationJa: 選手はラケットでボールに軽く触れて動かします。
brush.translationEs: Los jugadores rozan suavemente la bola con la raqueta.
brush.example: Players brush the ball with the racket.

serve.simpleMeaning: The first hit in a point.
serve.contextMeaning: Serve is the first shot to start a point.
serve.translationJa: サーブはポイントの最初の打球です。
serve.translationEs: El saque es el primer golpe en un punto.
serve.example: Every point starts with a serve.

toss.simpleMeaning: To throw something lightly up into the air.
toss.contextMeaning: To toss means to throw the ball lightly upward.
toss.translationJa: トスはボールを軽く上に投げることです。
toss.example: Toss the ball nearly straight up.

bounce.simpleMeaning: To hit a surface and bounce back.
bounce.contextMeaning: Bounce means the ball hits and leaves the table surface.
bounce.translationJa: バウンドはボールが台に当たって跳ね返ることです。
bounce.translationEs: Rebotar después de golpear una superficie.
bounce.example: The ball bounces on both sides of the table.

table.simpleMeaning: A flat surface players hit the ball on.
table.contextMeaning: Table here means the flat surface where the ball bounces in table tennis.
table.translationJa: ここでのテーブルはボールが跳ねる平らな面のことです。
table.translationEs: Mesa: la superficie plana donde la bola rebota en tenis de mesa.
table.example: Its effect is easier to see after the ball hits the table.

ball.simpleMeaning: A small round object used in table tennis.
ball.contextMeaning: Ball means the small round object hit and bounced in table tennis.
ball.translationJa: ボールは卓球で打ち合う小さな球体です。
ball.translationEs: Pelota: objeto redondo y pequeño usado en tenis de mesa.
ball.example: Table tennis is fast, but small actions can change the ball.

tennis.simpleMeaning: Tennis is a sport with rackets and ball.
tennis.contextMeaning: Tennis here means the sport similar to table tennis but played outside on a big field.
tennis.translationJa: テニスはラケットとボールを使うスポーツです。
tennis.translationEs: Tenis: un deporte con raquetas y pelota.
tennis.example: Table tennis is fast, but small actions can change the ball.

first.simpleMeaning: The very first time something happens.
first.contextMeaning: First means the first time the ball touches the server's side of the table.
first.translationJa: 最初はボールがサーバー側に最初に触れることです。
first.translationEs: Primero: la primera vez que la bola toca el lado del servidor.
first.example: The ball first bounces on the server’s side of the table.

make.simpleMeaning: To cause or help to happen.
make.contextMeaning: Make means to produce spin by brushing the ball with racket.
make.translationJa: 作るはラケットでボールをこすってスピンを起こすこと。
make.translationEs: Hacer: crear el giro al rozar la bola con la raqueta.
make.example: Players brush the ball with the racket to make spin.

server.simpleMeaning: The person who serves the ball first.
server.contextMeaning: Server is the player who throws and hits the ball to start a point.
server.translationJa: サーバーはポイント開始でボールを出す人。
server.translationEs: Servidor: persona que inicia el punto lanzando la bola.
server.example: The server tosses it nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.

two.contextMeaning: Two means the number 2, like two Olympic stars here.
two.translationJa: ２は数字の「に」。ここはオリンピックのスター２人。
two.translationEs: Dos: el número 2, como las dos estrellas olímpicas.
two.example: Explore spin, a legal serve, the sport’s early days, and two Olympic stars.

sport.simpleMeaning: A game or physical activity with rules.
sport.contextMeaning: Sport here means game or activity people play for fun or competition.
sport.translationJa: スポーツはルールがある遊びや運動。
sport.translationEs: Deporte: actividad con reglas para jugar o competir.
sport.example: Explore spin, a legal serve, the sport’s early days, and two Olympic stars.

title.simpleMeaning: A prize or name for winning a competition.
title.contextMeaning: Title means the award or name for winning a sports competition.
title.translationJa: タイトルは競技で勝ったときの賞や名前。
title.translationEs: Título: premio o nombre de quien gana una competencia.

around.simpleMeaning: Near or around a place or object.
around.contextMeaning: Around means near or close by the players’ equipment or place.

became.simpleMeaning: To change into a new state or form.
became.contextMeaning: Became means changed to be more organized later.

became.translationEs: Convertirse: cambiar a un estado nuevo.
became.example: The sport later became more organised.

began.contextMeaning: Began means the time when table tennis started in England.
began.translationJa: ビガンは卓球が始まった時の意味。
began.translationEs: Empezó: el momento cuando comenzó el tenis de mesa.
began.example: Table tennis began in England in the 1880s.

bounces.simpleMeaning: The ball hits the table and goes up.
bounces.contextMeaning: Bounces means the ball hits a surface and moves away.
bounces.translationJa: バウンスはボールが当たって跳ね返る。

change.simpleMeaning: To make something different or new.
change.contextMeaning: Change means to make the ball move differently.

changes.contextMeaning: Changes means a player makes the next shot different.

fast.contextMeaning: Fast means moving or happening very quickly in table tennis.
fast.translationJa: 速いはとても速く動くこと。
fast.translationEs: Rápido: que ocurre o se mueve muy rápido.
fast.example: Table tennis is fast, but small actions can change the ball.

hits.contextMeaning: Hits means the ball touches or strikes the table surface.
hits.translationJa: ヒットはボールが台に当たること。
hits.translationEs: Golpear: cuando la bola toca algo.

indoor.contextMeaning: Indoor means something happens inside a building, not outside.
indoor.translationJa: 屋内は建物の中のこと。

international.simpleMeaning: Between countries or all over the world.
international.example: A game for indoor tables had become an international sport.

next.contextMeaning: Next means the shot or thing that comes after now.
next.translationJa: 次は今の後に来ること。
next.example: A player watches the bounce and changes the next shot.

place.simpleMeaning: A spot or location where something is done.
place.contextMeaning: Place means the position where the ball is sent or hit.
place.translationJa: 場所はボールを送る位置のこと。
place.translationEs: Lugar: sitio donde se hace algo.
place.example: A server can change the speed, place, and spin.

players.contextMeaning: Players are the people who play table tennis.
players.translationJa: プレイヤーは卓球をする人。
players.example: Today, the table is still small, but players compete around the world.

represents.simpleMeaning: To stand for or be a symbol of a country or team.
represents.contextMeaning: Represents means Ma Long stands for China in sports.
represents.translationJa: 代表は馬龍が中国を表すこと。
represents.translationEs: Representa: ser símbolo de un país o grupo.

result.simpleMeaning: The result is what happens after trying or playing.
result.contextMeaning: Result means what shows success after competing.
result.translationJa: 結果は競技の後に出る成功。
result.translationEs: Resultado: lo que pasa después de un esfuerzo.
result.example: Ma Long’s result shows success across two Olympic Games.

see.simpleMeaning: To see with eyes or watch carefully.
see.contextMeaning: See means to look and notice something.
see.translationJa: 見るは目で見たり気づくこと。
see.example: Spin is often hard to see before the bounce.

shot.simpleMeaning: A hit of the ball using racket.
shot.contextMeaning: Shot means a hit or strike with the racket.
shot.translationJa: ショットはラケットでボールを打つこと。
shot.translationEs: Golpe: acción de golpear la bola.

side.simpleMeaning: One part or side of something.
side.contextMeaning: Side means one half or section of the table.
side.translationJa: サイドは台の一つの側面。
side.example: The ball first bounces on the server’s side of the table.

simple.contextMeaning: Simple means not difficult and easy to understand or do.

singles.simpleMeaning: One player alone, not doubles or teams.
singles.contextMeaning: Singles means games with only one player on each side.
singles.translationJa: シングルスは一人ずつで行う試合。
singles.translationEs: Individual: juego con un jugador por lado.
singles.example: He won the Olympic men’s singles title in 2016 and again at Tokyo 2020.

small.simpleMeaning: Not big in size or amount.
small.contextMeaning: Small means little in size or number.
small.translationJa: 小さいは大きくないこと。
small.example: Table tennis is fast, but small actions can change the ball.

won.simpleMeaning: To get first place or victory in a game.
won.contextMeaning: Won means to get victory or first place.
won.translationJa: 勝つは試合に勝ったこと。
won.translationEs: Ganar: tener éxito en un juego.
won.example: He won the Olympic men’s singles title in 2016 and again at Tokyo 2020.

world.simpleMeaning: The whole Earth and all countries.
world.contextMeaning: World means all places and people on Earth.
world.translationJa: 世界は地球と全ての国や人。
world.translationEs: Mundo: todo el planeta y sus personas.
world.example: Today, the table is still small, but players compete around the world.

across.simpleMeaning: From one side to the other side of something.
across.contextMeaning: Across means from one part to the other side.
across.translationEs: A través de: de un lado a otro.
across.example: Ma Long’s result shows success across two Olympic Games.

actions.contextMeaning: Actions means moves or things done by players.
actions.translationJa: アクションは人がする動きや行動。
actions.translationEs: Acciones: cosas que las personas hacen.
actions.example: Table tennis is fast, but small actions can change the ball.

basic.simpleMeaning: Basic means simple and important parts.
basic.contextMeaning: Basic means the three main kinds of spin are simple and main.
basic.translationJa: 基本は大切で簡単な部分。
basic.example: The three basic kinds are topspin, backspin, and sidespin.

become.simpleMeaning: To become or change into something new.
become.contextMeaning: Become means change into a new form or state.
become.translationJa: なるは新しい形や状態へ変わること。
become.example: A game for indoor tables had become an international sport.

begins.simpleMeaning: To start or happen from a beginning point.
begins.contextMeaning: Begins means to start, like the ball starting on open palm.
begins.translationJa: 始まるは何かが始まること。
begins.example: In an official serve, the ball begins on an open palm.

centimetres.simpleMeaning: Centimetres are units to measure length or height.
centimetres.contextMeaning: Centimetres are metric units used to measure height or distances.
centimetres.translationJa: センチメートルは長さや高さの単位。
centimetres.translationEs: Centímetros: unidades de medida de longitud.
centimetres.example: The server tosses it nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.

compete.simpleMeaning: To try to win against others in a game.
compete.contextMeaning: Compete means to play against others to win.
compete.translationJa: 競うは勝つために他と戦うこと。
compete.translationEs: Competir: jugar para ganar contra otros.
compete.example: Today, the table is still small, but players compete around the world.

create.simpleMeaning: To make or cause something to happen.
create.contextMeaning: Create means to make something new, like movements making play fun.
create.translationJa: 作るは新しいものを生み出す。

curve.simpleMeaning: To bend in a curve shape.

days.contextMeaning: Days means times or periods in the past early times.

different.simpleMeaning: Different means not the same or changed.

difficult.simpleMeaning: Difficult means hard or not easy.
difficult.contextMeaning: Difficult means something is hard to do or understand.
difficult.translationJa: 難しいは簡単でないこと。
difficult.example: These changes can make the next shot difficult.

dining.simpleMeaning: Dining means used for eating meals.
dining.contextMeaning: Dining means for eating food, like dining table.
dining.translationJa: ダイニングは食事をするための。

dip.simpleMeaning: To go down or sink a little.

doubles.simpleMeaning: Doubles means two players on a side in a game.

early.simpleMeaning: Early means near the beginning of time or event.

effect.contextMeaning: Effect is the change or result after something.
effect.translationJa: 効果は何かの結果や変化。

equipment.simpleMeaning: Equipment means tools or things used for a purpose.
equipment.contextMeaning: Equipment means the things needed to play table tennis.

event.simpleMeaning: Event means an important occasion or competition.

exciting.simpleMeaning: Exciting means making you feel happy or interested.

exciting.translationJa: わくわくするは楽しく興味を持つこと。
exciting.translationEs: Emocionante: que te hace feliz o interesado.
exciting.example: Watch how simple movements create exciting play.

falls.simpleMeaning: Falls means goes down from a height or position.
falls.contextMeaning: Falls means the ball moves down in the air.
falls.translationJa: 落ちるは上から下へ動くこと。

firsts.simpleMeaning: Firsts means the very first times something happens.

form.simpleMeaning: Form means a type or way of doing something.

game.simpleMeaning: Game means a play or match with rules.

gold.simpleMeaning: Gold means the first prize or medal color for winners.

hard.simpleMeaning: Hard means difficult or not easy.

hard.example: Spin is often hard to see before the bounce.

important.simpleMeaning: Important means very needed or special.
important.contextMeaning: Important means something very needed or good to know.
important.translationJa: 重要はとても必要で特別なこと。

kinds.simpleMeaning: Kinds means types or groups of things.

kinds.translationJa: 種類は違うタイプのこと。

later.simpleMeaning: Later means after some time has passed.
later.contextMeaning: Later means after now, in the future or after time.
later.translationJa: 後でとは今より後のこと。
later.example: The sport later became more organised.

lawn.simpleMeaning: Lawn is a grass field used for playing sports.
lawn.contextMeaning: Lawn means grass field outside used for tennis.
lawn.translationJa: 芝生はスポーツで使う草の場所。
lawn.translationEs: Césped: lugar de hierba para jugar.
lawn.example: People played it as an indoor form of lawn tennis.

least.simpleMeaning: Least means the smallest or minimum amount.
least.contextMeaning: Least means the smallest amount allowed, like 16 cm toss up.
least.translationJa: 最小は一番少ない量の意味。
least.example: The server tosses it nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.

left.simpleMeaning: Left means the side on the left when facing forward.
left.contextMeaning: Left means to the left side of a person or object.
left.translationJa: 左は向いている時の左側。

legal.simpleMeaning: Legal means allowed by rules or law.

legal.translationJa: 合法はルールに従っていること。
legal.example: Explore spin, a legal serve, the sport’s early days, and two Olympic stars.

low.simpleMeaning: Low means near the bottom or not high.

man.simpleMeaning: Man means an adult male person.

marks.simpleMeaning: Marks means shows or is a sign of something.

mixed.simpleMeaning: Mixed means made of different types together.

move.simpleMeaning: Move means to change position or go somewhere.

nearly.example: The server tosses it nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.

official.simpleMeaning: Official means authorized or accepted by rules.
official.contextMeaning: Official means following the rules and accepted.
official.translationJa: 公式はルールに従う正式なもの。
official.example: In an official serve, the ball begins on an open palm.

often.simpleMeaning: Often means many times or frequently.
often.contextMeaning: Often means many times or regularly.
often.translationJa: よくは何度もあること。
often.example: Spin is often hard to see before the bounce.

one.simpleMeaning: One means the number 1 or a single thing.
one.contextMeaning: One means a single, not two or more things.
one.translationJa: 一は数字の１。単数の意味。
one.example: Mima Ito’s result marks two important firsts in one event.

organised.simpleMeaning: Organised means arranged and planned well.
organised.contextMeaning: Organised means planned and structured carefully.
organised.translationJa: 整理されているは計画的に整っている。
organised.example: The sport later became more organised.

other.simpleMeaning: Other means different or another one.
other.contextMeaning: Other means the side not first, the second side.
other.translationJa: 他のは最初でない別のもの。
other.example: Then it bounces on the other side.

palm.simpleMeaning: Palm is the inside part of the hand.
palm.contextMeaning: Palm means the flat inside part of your hand.
palm.translationJa: 手のひらは手の中の平らな部分。
palm.translationEs: Palma: parte plana de la mano.
palm.example: In an official serve, the ball begins on an open palm.

play.simpleMeaning: Play means to do a game or have fun.
play.contextMeaning: Play means to enjoy or do the game.
play.translationJa: 遊ぶはゲームや楽しみをすること。
play.translationEs: Jugar: hacer un juego o divertirse.
play.example: Watch how simple movements create exciting play.

played.simpleMeaning: Played means did or took part in a game or sport.
played.contextMeaning: Played means people did a game or sport.
played.translationJa: したは試合やスポーツをやる。
played.translationEs: Jugado: haber participado en un juego.
played.example: People played it as an indoor form of lawn tennis.

player.simpleMeaning: Player is a person who plays a game.
player.contextMeaning: Player means the person playing table tennis.
player.translationJa: プレイヤーはゲームをする人。
player.example: A player watches the bounce and changes the next shot.

point.simpleMeaning: Point means a unit of scoring in a game.
point.contextMeaning: Point means a score unit in table tennis or sport.
point.translationJa: ポイントはゲームの得点の単位。
point.example: Every point starts with a serve.

points.simpleMeaning: Points means counts of scores for players.
points.contextMeaning: Points means many scoring units in games.
points.translationJa: ポイントは複数の得点のこと。
points.example: A short backspin serve and a fast topspin serve can start two very different points.

quickly.simpleMeaning: Quickly means doing something very fast.
quickly.contextMeaning: Quickly means fast in a short time.
quickly.translationJa: 速くは短時間に速くすること。
quickly.example: Topspin makes the ball dip and move forward quickly after the bounce.

racket.simpleMeaning: Racket is the wooden tool with strings to hit the ball.
racket.contextMeaning: Racket means the tool players use to hit the ball.
racket.translationJa: ラケットはボールを打つ道具。
racket.translationEs: Raqueta: herramienta para golpear la bola.
racket.example: Players brush the ball with the racket to make spin.

right.simpleMeaning: Right means the side on the right when facing forward.
right.contextMeaning: Right means on the right side of a person or object.
right.translationJa: 右は向いている時の右側。
right.example: Sidespin can make it curve left or right.

short.simpleMeaning: Short means not long or small in length.
short.contextMeaning: Short means little in length or time.
short.translationJa: 短いは長さや時間が小さい。
short.example: A short backspin serve and a fast topspin serve can start two very different points.

shows.simpleMeaning: Shows means makes clear or easy to see.
shows.contextMeaning: Shows means to make information or feelings visible.
shows.translationJa: 示すはわかりやすくすること。
shows.example: Ma Long’s result shows success across two Olympic Games.

slow.simpleMeaning: Slow means moving with little speed.
slow.contextMeaning: Slow means not fast, moving gently.
slow.translationJa: 遅いはゆっくり動くこと。
slow.example: Backspin can make it stay low and slow.

speed.simpleMeaning: Speed means how fast something moves.
speed.contextMeaning: Speed is how quickly the ball moves.
speed.translationJa: 速度は物が速く動く速さ。
speed.translationEs: Velocidad: qué rápido se mueve algo.
speed.example: A server can change the speed, place, and spin.

stars.simpleMeaning: Stars means famous or top players or people.
stars.contextMeaning: Stars means very good and well-known players.
stars.translationJa: スターはとても上手で有名な人。
stars.translationEs: Estrellas: personas muy buenas o famosas.
stars.example: Explore spin, a legal serve, the sport’s early days, and two Olympic stars.

start.contextMeaning: Start means to begin, like a serve starting a point.
start.translationJa: 始めるは何かが始まること。
start.example: A short backspin serve and a fast topspin serve can start two very different points.

starts.contextMeaning: Starts means to begin, like a game or point.
starts.translationJa: スタートは最初に始めること。
starts.example: Every point starts with a serve.

stay.simpleMeaning: Stay means to remain in the same place or state.
stay.contextMeaning: Stay means the ball remains low and slow without rising.
stay.translationJa: とどまるは同じ場所や状態にいる。
stay.translationEs: Quedarse: no cambiar de lugar o estado.
stay.example: Backspin can make it stay low and slow.

still.contextMeaning: Still means something continues as before now.
still.translationJa: まだは今もそのままである。
still.example: Today, the table is still small, but players compete around the world.

straight.simpleMeaning: Straight means in a direct line, not curved.
straight.contextMeaning: Straight means the ball goes straight up when tossed.
straight.translationJa: まっすぐは曲がらずに真っ直ぐの意味。
straight.example: The server tosses it nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.

success.simpleMeaning: Success means doing something well or winning.
success.contextMeaning: Success means good results or achievements.
success.translationJa: 成功はうまくいくこと。
success.example: Ma Long’s result shows success across two Olympic Games.

tables.simpleMeaning: Tables means more than one table.
tables.contextMeaning: Tables means more than one flat surface for playing.
tables.translationJa: テーブルは複数の机や台のこと。
tables.example: A game for indoor tables had become an international sport.

three.example: The three basic kinds are topspin, backspin, and sidespin.

took.simpleMeaning: Took means to get or have something in the past.
took.contextMeaning: Took means to have an event happen in the past.
took.translationJa: 取ったは過去に起こった意味。
took.example: The first World Championships also took place in 1926, in London.

tosses.simpleMeaning: Tosses means throws lightly up into the air.
tosses.contextMeaning: Tosses means the server throws the ball up gently.
tosses.translationJa: トスはボールを軽く上に投げること。
tosses.example: The server tosses it nearly straight up at least 16 centimetres.

twice.contextMeaning: Twice means something happened two times.
twice.translationEs: Dos veces: algo sucede dos veces.
twice.example: He became the first man to win this Olympic singles title twice.

used.simpleMeaning: Used means employed or made use of something.
used.contextMeaning: Used means to have used a table or equipment.
used.translationJa: 使ったは何かを使ったこと。
used.example: They used a dining table and simple equipment they had around them.

watches.simpleMeaning: Watches means looks carefully at something.
watches.contextMeaning: Watches means to look closely, like watching the bounce.
watches.translationJa: 見るは注意して見ること。
watches.example: A player watches the bounce and changes the next shot.

win.simpleMeaning: Win means to be better or first in a game.
win.contextMeaning: Win means to succeed and be first or champion.
win.translationJa: 勝つは試合で一番になる。
win.translationEs: Ganar: ser el mejor o primero.
win.example: He became the first man to win this Olympic singles title twice.
